  "id" : "one",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "remainingTimes" : 3
  }
}
JSON, true)));

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{

  },

JSON, true)));

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "path" : "/some_other_path"

    "body" : {
      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "some_other_body",

    "unlimited" : true

    "unlimited" : true
  },

}
JSON, true)));

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'

  "httpRequest" : {
    "path" : "/quotes"
  },

      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "a \"quoted\" `tick` \"# raw ''' \"\"\" \\ end",
      "rawBytes" : "YSAicXVvdGVkIiBgdGlja2AgIiMgcmF3ICcnJyAiIiIgXCBlbmQ="
    }
  },
  "id" : "five",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  }
}
JSON, true)));

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "path" : "/target"

    "statusCode" : 202,

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/fwd")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)
                .withBody(new StringBody("fwd body")),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(202)
                .withReasonPhrase("Accepted")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("connection", "keep-alive"),
                        new Header("content-length", "11"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("from target")
);

<?php

use MockServer\MockServerClient;
use MockServer\Expectation;

$client = new MockServerClient('localhost', <port>);

$client->upsertExpectation(Expectation::fromArray(json_decode(<<<'JSON'
{
  "httpRequest" : {
    "method" : "POST",
    "path" : "/fwd",
    "headers" : {
      "host" : [ "localhost:<port>" ]
    },
    "keepAlive" : true,
    "secure" : false,
    "protocol" : "HTTP_1_1",
    "localAddress" : "<address>",
    "remoteAddress" : "<address>",
    "body" : {
      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "fwd body",
      "rawBytes" : "ZndkIGJvZHk="
    }
  },
  "httpResponse" : {
    "statusCode" : 202,
    "reasonPhrase" : "Accepted",
    "headers" : {
      "x-mockserver-response-time-ms" : [ "<ms>" ],
      "content-length" : [ "11" ],
      "connection" : [ "keep-alive" ]
    },
    "body" : {
      "type" : "STRING",
      "string" : "from target",
      "rawBytes" : "ZnJvbSB0YXJnZXQ="
    }
  },
  "id" : "<uuid>",
  "priority" : 0,
  "timeToLive" : {
    "unlimited" : true
  },
  "times" : {
    "remainingTimes" : 1
  }
}
JSON, true)));

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/fwd")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)
                .withBody(new StringBody("fwd body")),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(202)
                .withReasonPhrase("Accepted")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("connection", "keep-alive"),
                        new Header("content-length", "11"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("from target")
);

new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/fwd-json")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("content-type", "application/json"),
                        new Header("cookie", "z=1; y=2"),
                        new Header("x-custom", "c"),
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("y", "2"),
                        new Cookie("z", "1")
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter("b", "2", "3"),
                        new Parameter("a", "1")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)
                .withBody(new JsonBody("{\"k\" :  [1, 2.0]}", JsonBodyMatchType.ONLY_MATCHING_FIELDS)),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Content-Type", "application/json"),
                        new Header("X-B", "1"),
                        new Header("X-A", "2"),
                        new Header("set-cookie", "s=t"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("s", "t")
                )
                .withBody("{\"r\": 1.50}")
);
